title: Bug: telemetry tests: DNS resolution failed for py_gnmicli.py for mgmt IPv6 only setup
author: markx-arista
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Topo: m0
Telemetry tests for IPv6 mgmt IP fail due to DNS resolution failure

### Steps to Reproduce

Run telemetry tests with mgmt IPv6 only setups.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Telemetry tests should pass.

linkedPullRequests.title: Patch PTF gnxi for telemetry tests failures in mgmt IPv6 only setups
linkedPullRequests.author: markx-arista
linkedPullRequests.body:
py_gnmicli.py from gnxi library in PTF container doesn't handle IPv6 + port properly e.g. [addr]:port when passing it to grpc functions.

Fixes: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24400

#### Why I did it

Telemetry tests failed for mgmt IPv6 only setups

#### How I did it

Patch gnxi library for PTF container, add square brackets to IPv6 address before combining with port.

#### How to verify it

Telemetry tests should pass.

#### Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)

- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202211
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [x] 202505

#### Tested branch (Please provide the tested image version)

- [x] 202505

#### Description for the changelog

Fix IPv6 addr + port format for grpc.

comments.author: markx-arista
comments.body:
> Hi @markx-arista, question about target self, what if target has square bracket, so, could we check target first then append. Thanks!

Hi, I originally tried to workaround this problem by passing the ipv6 addr with brackets from sonic-mgmt, but there were failures in _build_creds() function because socket library calls failed with brackets.
The whole py_gnmicli.py doesn't have any input check, so we should just expect users to input correct formats.
